Consider the following initial value problem:

$$
{y}^{′}=y,\,y(0)=1
$$

Suppose we wish to approximate the solution using Euler's method:

$$
\begin{aligned}Δy & ={y}^{′}\cdot Δx \\ {y}_{\text{new}} & =y+Δy\end{aligned}
$$

Given that the exact solution is ${y}_{\text{exact}}(x)={e}^{x},$ compute the local truncation error ${τ}_{21}$ for the step starting at $x=1$ with step size $Δx=0.05.$ Round your answer to three decimal places.
